policy: Fixed application full-card/region metrics across all 316 native rasters; only 282 accepted interior poses scored. Original wording is not fully verified, so these are exploratory before/after diagnostics, not complete-set compliance or certified typography. Previously reused scans remain development data. Shared renderer parameters were frozen before scoring; rejected normalizations remain in the denominator. Type lines and any unverified/fallback rules are explicitly excluded from weighted structural scores using stored printing provenance. Their diagnostics remain visible. Copyright and other low-signal/unverified regions keep the application gates. Numbers are similarity indices over eligible regions, not percentages of correctness. The native early-expansion rasters precede the M21-only extension; its 580-probe compatibility receipt preserves early-set selectors. No local or hosted scores are silently relabeled as a newer renderer revision.

compatibleExtensions.policy: Materials and mana unchanged across all 645 selectors. Historical pigment metrics keep their original reference poses and renderer hash.

Only ordinary nonlegendary M21 red frame pigment changes. All 645 mana/stock probes and 601 unrelated material selectors are identical. Complete native replay with original rules preserves all 250 unrelated M21 rasters, and core art/paper, stock and alpha on all 292 cards. Earlier metrics keep their original renderer and input hashes; red color measurements are superseded only by the new receipt. Frozen scan-only poses and geometry remain unchanged.
